column2: This is an essentially follow-up to https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50315409 “NASA's Voyager 1 mysteriously lost touch with Earth” (mashable.com)

Are there any projects/plans to send more probes to interstellar space? I mean Voyager is great and all, but it’s old and it seems it’s days are counted. More contemporary technology could bring us farer and more data on the long run.
